description: Restorative caster - mends allies with venom-born medicine. Tree of Life-equivalent spec; Vizier Form is this spec's shapeshift.
_source_note: Rebuilt from CoA Build Hub screenshots (Sept 2026): 10 confirmed Vizier nodes expanded slightly to a 12-node tree (a couple class-wide-flavored 'Other' bucket abilities folded in, matching Storm Ascendance's precedent from Stormbringer) since Vizier's real source list was noticeably smaller than the other 3 specs. Shadra's Vigil confirmed via tooltip as the capstone: 'Healing done by Serpent's Fang now applies Shadra's Vigil to allies. The next 5 instances of periodic healing by you on this target will heal them for an additional 10% of the value.'
